description: This file is a shell script for performing firmware upgrades on an OpenWRT-based device, specifically handling NAND and NOR flash memory upgrades, and managing boot configurations with functions like 'glinet_using_boot_dev_switch', 'glinet_set_next_boot_nand', and 'glinet_set_next_boot_nor'.

methods.name: glinet_using_boot_dev_switch
methods.description: Checks if the boot device switch is enabled by reading environment variable 'boot_dev'.

methods.name: glinet_set_next_boot_nand
methods.description: Prepares the device to boot from NAND on the next startup by resetting bootcount and optionally switching boot device.

methods.name: glinet_set_next_boot_nor
methods.description: Prepares the device to boot from NOR flash on the next startup.

methods.name: glinet_nand_nor_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs upgrade by selecting between NAND or NOR upgrade functions based on the provided upgrade file.

methods.name: nand_nor_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade handler that detects firmware type and calls appropriate upgrade functions while setting next boot options.
